description: arXiv:2609.24504v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Fine-tuned checkpoints and adapters now fill public repositories, and the most common operation applied to these artifacts is model merging: arithmetic on their weights that assembles capabilities cheaply. We ask what this operation does to emergent capabilities: behaviors an artifact carries that were never an explicit training target....
author: Luca Zhou, Emanuele Rodol\`a
